data_quality_notes: Market size figures from Research and Markets and Mordor Intelligence use different market definitions (AI-specific vs. total CLM); use both for context, citing the definition
Ironclad and Icertis ARR/revenue figures are either company-reported or Sacra estimates — treat as directional
The 9% revenue leakage figure (World Commerce & Contracting) is widely cited by vendors but primary methodology not independently verified
PeerSpot mindshare % reflects user engagement, not revenue market share — useful for comparative positioning only
